name: Components Extras
description: Provide components plugin and an associated render element for developers
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Components extras module provides a Drupal render element to use Twig components from the Components module in render arrays.

 Requirements 
 No special requirements.

 Recommended modules 
 No specific recommendations, you can use this module as is.

 Roadmap 
 This module is minimally maintained. It will be updated if needed but no further development is planned.

 Known problems
